# Podcast & newsletter block

Adds a **Podcast & Newsletter** section to `index.html`, between
*Watch selected interventions* and the keynotes block.

## How it works

`update_content.py` fetches the latest content and rewrites everything between
these two markers in `index.html`:

```html
<!-- CONTENT:START — generated by update_content.py, do not edit by hand -->
<!-- CONTENT:END -->
```

| Source | Where the data comes from | Reliability |
|---|---|---|
| Podcast | Official Apple Podcasts lookup API (`itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=1543657106`) — title, Apple episode link, date, duration, description, artwork | Stable public API |
| Newsletter | The public LinkedIn newsletter page, plus each article's Open Graph tags for the cover image and standfirst | Scraped — LinkedIn has no API or RSS for newsletters, so this can break if they change their markup |

LinkedIn exposes no feed for newsletters, so scraping the public page is the only
way to do this automatically. If it ever stops working, the script keeps the last
good copy from `content.json` instead of emptying the section, and the run fails
loudly so you know to look.

## Run it

```bash
python3 update_content.py index.html
```

No dependencies beyond the Python standard library. It is idempotent — running it
twice with nothing new prints `no change` and touches nothing.

## Automate it

Copy `workflows/update-content.yml` to `.github/workflows/update-content.yml`.
It refreshes the section every Monday and commits only when something changed.
You can also trigger it by hand from the repo's **Actions** tab.

## Tuning

At the top of `update_content.py`:

- `N_EPISODES` / `N_ARTICLES` — how many cards to show (3 each; the grid is
  built for 3, 6 or 9)
- `BOILERPLATE` — recurring opening lines stripped from the card excerpts
